selected.title: Nubank in talks to take over Monzo
selected.summary: Brazilian neobank Nubank is reportedly eyeing a takeover of UK digital bank Monzo, in a deal that would value the British challenger at $10 billion.
selected.why: Major cross-border fintech M&A talks valuing Monzo at $10 billion.

reason: UK-relevant fintech M&A with arguable implications for UK financial services regulation and consumer choice in digital banking.
angle: Foreign acquisition of Monzo may accelerate UK digital banking innovation but raises questions about regulatory jurisdiction and data sovereignty.
